rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “shot” means an opportunity or chance to try.

example.english: I finally got a shot to try this time.
example.traditional: 我今次終於有機會試吓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 zung1 jyu1 jau5 gei1 wui6 si3 haa5

rows.note: Use this for a single photograph or snapshot, rather than a moving-film shot.

example.english: Take a shot of me here—the lighting is beautiful.
example.traditional: 呢度光線咁靚，幫我影一張相啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 gwong1 sin3 gam3 leng3 bong1 ngo5 jeng2 jat1 zoeng1 soeng2 laa1

rows.note: Use this in the medical context for a vaccination or injection, as in “a tetanus shot.”

example.english: Remember to get your shot tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 gei3 zyu6 heoi3 daa2 zam1 aa3

rows.note: Use this for one shot fired from a gun, especially when describing where it hit.

example.english: They fired a shot and hit the bullseye.
example.traditional: 佢開咗一槍，射中個靶心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hoi1 zo2 jat1 coeng1 se6 zung3 go3 baa2 sam1
